_comment: Threats with no test and no attack, and why. A reason must stay true: tests/test_threat_coverage.py fails when a threat here also has a test.

reasons.T12: A person is the target, so code cannot prove the result. What code can do is covered under T5 and E2: new recipients are tagged and full addresses shown.
reasons.T30: Accepted on purpose: emails disclose that an agent sent them (invariant 10), and T1-T7 must hold anyway. There is nothing to test.
reasons.E11: No cancelling or moving events yet: the only actions are a reply and a new event. Needs tests when UC-M4 and UC-M5 are built.
reasons.E12: A human factor. Measuring it needs real use over time, and the MVP has no such data.
